items.title: What Do Pfizer (PFE) Investors Need To Know About The New Patent Lawsuits?
items.summary: Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) faces new patent lawsuits from Arbutus Biopharma and Genevant in Japan and an expanded case in Canada over lipid nanoparticle technology used in its COVID-19 vaccines. The Japanese filing requests an injunction on Pfizer's mRNA COVID-19 vaccine products and seeks damages tied to alleged lipid nanoparticle patent use. In Canada, Arbutus and Genevant now seek broader remedies including an injunction and royalties linked to Pfizer's COVID-19 vaccine sales in that market. The...

items.title: Pfizer’s CEO Wants AI to “Halve the Time to First Human Study.” Here’s What That Means for Its Pipeline
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPfizer CEO Albert Bourla wants AI to cut the time to a drug’s first human study from four years to two, then halve the time from there to approval. Faster lab work pays off in the 2030s, since nothing Pfizer starts now reaches human trials before generic Eliquis arrives in 2028.
